fato_historico: 2004: Over 3,000 people die in Haiti after Hurricane Jeanne produces massive flooding and mudslides.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a poignant reminder of life's delicate fragility, much like how nature humbles the earth with sudden rains. Consider the deep resilience found in those who rise after storms. It is a good time to channel your Gemini duality toward healing, nurturing connections, and finding hope in the steady rebuilding of your inner landscape.
frase_do_dia: Even after the heaviest rain, the earth blooms with renewed and vibrant life.
significado_numero: Represents the dynamic duality and the rhythm of life's cycles.
conselho: Focus on grounding your thoughts and offer kindness to those around you today.
